log.message: nice and cool / lovely and cool

log.label: 中文
log.message: 晚上在红城湖湖边散散步，还是非常愉悦的。有微风，很凉爽。

log.label: 英文 A
log.message: Taking a walk along the edge of Hongcheng Lake — an evening stroll here is really delightful. There's a nice breeze, nice and cool.

log.label: 英文 B
log.message: Walking by Hongcheng Lake in the evening is genuinely pleasant. The breeze is lovely and cool.
